stem:
Priya wants to find the north-south direction in her school playground in Jaipur.
She has a bar magnet, a piece of thread, and a compass.
What should she do to find the north-south direction?

options.text: Place the bar magnet on the ground and read its direction at once
Hang the bar magnet with the thread and wait until it comes to rest
Hold the compass in her hand while walking towards the Sun
Tie the bar magnet tightly to a wooden stick and turn it around

teacher.key_rationale: A freely suspended magnet must be left to swing until it comes to rest; only then does it settle along the north-south direction. Reading it while it is still moving (A), using a moving compass (C), or fixing the magnet so it cannot turn freely (D) all drop the condition of free suspension at rest, so B is correct.
